Definition: used adverbially (with preposition) at or upon the side of
BiblicalUsage: tsad is the word for at or upon the side of. It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Daniel 6:4 and Daniel 7:25.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us tsad because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
